scripts.build:classic: vite build --mode classic && node scripts/patch-manifest.mjs classic
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.check:classic: npm run typecheck && npm run build:classic
scripts.smoke:classic: npm run build:classic && node scripts/worker-smoke.mjs dist-classic
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run unit && npm run smoke && npm run artifact
scripts.verify:classic: npm run check:classic && npm run unit && npm run smoke:classic && npm run artifact:classic
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:classic
